26.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="34">3. Application</text></g>

22.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="32" x="0" y="32">the number of columns in the first matrix (A)</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="32" x="0" y="74.24">must be equal to the number of rows in the</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="32" x="0" y="116.48">second matrix (B)</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="32" x="0" y="158.72">A: m × n</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="32" x="0" y="200.96">B: n × p</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="32" x="0" y="243.2">C: m × p</text></g>

19.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="30" x="0" y="30">Each entry of C = AB is a dot</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="30" x="0" y="69.6">product:</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="30" x="0" y="109.2">c_ij = (row i of A) · (col j of B)</text></g>

18.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text fill="#F1EFE9" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="31">A : [1 2]</text><text fill="#F1EFE9" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="71.92">B : [5; 7]</text><text fill="#F1EFE9" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="112.84">C = 1·5 + 2·7 = 19</text><text fill="#F1EFE9" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="153.76">shop 2: 3·5 + 4·7 = 43</text></g>

5.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="34">Each column of C is A times the matching column of B, so it is a linear</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="78.88">combination of the columns of A.</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="123.76">Each row of C is the matching row of A times B, a linear combination of the rows</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="168.64">of B.</text></g>

7.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="35" x="0" y="35">take a row from the first matrix and a column from the second matrix, multiply</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="35" x="0" y="81.2">their corresponding numbers together, and then add those products up.</text></g>

13.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="34">A : [ 1; 2; 3]</text><text font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="78.88">B : [1 3 ]</text><text font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="34" x="0" y="123.76">AB =[ 1 3; 2 6; 3 9]</text></g>

4.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="30" x="0" y="30">Only exists when the matrices is</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="30" x="0" y="69.6">a square and the determinant ≠</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="30" x="0" y="109.2">0</text></g>

Decrypting needs K⁻¹, so a</text><text fill="#2B3447" font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="71.92">singular key cannot decrypt.</text></g>
